notes: Deploy HamsterMiningReserve on Sepolia (chain 11155111), wired directly to Squeekchain GRAPH C v9. Constructor arguments are owner, Genesis NFT, staking, emission engine, SqueekCore and existing SQK reward asset, in that order. $owner receives ownership (Ownable2Step, renounce disabled) and is the initial strategist; the strategist role follows a completed ownership handover unless the owner has appointed a separate strategist. The constructor only stores addresses and makes no external calls. All five external graph contracts already exist and are not deployed by this manifest. Deposited NFTs form a permanent reserve; shares are credited only against added accountPower. hmSQUEEK is the vault's internal transferable share ledger, with no pre-created or sold shares, separate asset, pool or pair. Holders claim pro-rata SQK or transfer shares to exit. No initialization calls or deployment funding are required.
